articles.title: Teens Chase 200 Birds in 24 Hours at the World Series of Birding!
articles.summary: Three teenagers sprinted through a dark New Jersey park at midnight to spot a sleeping monk parakeet. They're competing to count the most bird species in 24 hours. Last year they tied for first with 199 species.

articles.title: Gas Prices Jump 44% as War with Iran Hits Your Wallet
articles.summary: Gas now costs over $4.50 a gallon on average—up 44% from last year. The war with Iran has blocked a key oil route, pushing prices higher. Inflation rose 3.8% in April, the biggest jump in three years.

articles.title: eBay Says No to GameStop's $56 Billion Buyout Offer
articles.summary: GameStop wanted to buy eBay for $56 billion, but eBay said the offer wasn't believable or good. eBay's stock has done well, and it doubts GameStop can pay. GameStop's CEO might try to convince eBay's shareholders directly.
